documented_probe: C-6dcccfe8 (filter a large dataset to a given locale subset and export columns to jsonl): reference floor is medium and this covering task is medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases.
notes: Single-stage: filter a JSONL survey archive to one locale and export dotted-path column selectors to JSONL. Medium via nested-path resolution with missing-key -> "" handling plus adversarial lines (malformed JSON, non-object JSON, blank lines) and a zero-match/empty-file edge. Hidden cases cover a different locale, reordered selectors, unicode preservation, and an empty input. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (dotted-path semantics), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (5 hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact rows, order, column names). No tools, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.
